partitionRecipes.P1: cycling byte lengths 2,5,1,3; truncate final chunk

seedCandidates.bomRecipe: prefix plain with EF BB BF; separate candidates EF, EF BB at EOF, or EF BB BF inside the second cell
seedCandidates.crRecipe: replace plain line ends with CRLF; separate variants interior lone CR, trailing CR at EOF, CR at fresh record start
seedCandidates.quoteRecipe: quoted seed with EOF after opening quote / first byte of doubled quote / closing quote followed by x; no assigned malformed behavior
